impact_scope.description: Introduces the public QOI decoder implementing base.image_decoder, including its image-decoding lifecycle.

evidence: S0 has no matching decoder declaration in the selected source file.
Because the anchored QOI decoder did not exist in S0, H0 had no obligation to expose it.
S1 introduces pub struct decoder? implements base.image_decoder in std/qoi/decode_qoi.wuffs.
H0 enables only AUX_BASE, AUX_JSON, BASE, and JSON modules and calls only JSON decoding APIs; it neither enables QOI nor instantiates or calls the QOI decoder lifecycle.

new_harness_obligation.description: To expose the new QOI decoder, H0 must add QOI module configuration and a QOI decoding entry/path that supplies encoded input and exercises the image-decoder lifecycle, including destination pixel-buffer handling.
evidence: The QOI module and public decoder surface are newly introduced in S1.
No existing H0 call reaches the QOI decoder; all current semantic entry paths invoke JSON decoders.

reason: The anchored public QOI decoder is absent in S0, so Gap(S0,H0) is false. It exists in S1 but remains unreachable from the unchanged JSON-only harness, so Gap(S1,H0) is true. Exposing it requires concrete new harness configuration and calls, yielding NEW and therefore maintenance_needed=true.
